binding_policy.first_bind: persist caller-selected InputPortConsumerSpec plus exact input-port metadata snapshot
binding_policy.graph_without_binding: remains valid as an explicit lower-level escape hatch

binding_snapshot.binding_identity: deterministic fnv1a64 fingerprint over canonical binding fields

inputPortConsumerEdgeBinding.returns: persistent binding plus current input drift/compatibility status

drift_status.exact: current input metadata exactly matches bound snapshot
drift_status.drifted: current input metadata differs from bound snapshot
drift_status.unknown: semantic input metadata is currently unbound
drift_status.effect: observation only; never mutates topology or blocks execution

invariants: binding metadata is excluded from canonical graph plan bytes
binding metadata does not initialize or mutate LayerRegistry
binding metadata does not authorize execution
binding metadata does not infer consumer meaning from numerical layer type
binding applies only to a step that actually consumes slot 0
binding is immutable once created for a step
compatibility at bind may be incompatible because final decision authority remains with the agent
current drift is reported but never converted into automatic execution rejection
future_extensions: persistent bindings for multiple external input ports
proof receipts referencing semantic edge binding identity
